categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Modifies block template generation logging in src/node/miner.cpp and updates test/functional/mining_basic.py.
categories.rationale: Demotes CreateNewBlock() metrics logging to a debug category to prevent log spam. It has no impact on template validity, fee or weight accounting, latency, or mining interfaces.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and adds a new logging category in src/logging.cpp and src/logging/categories.h.
categories.rationale: Introduces a -debug=mining category to resolve persistent debug.log spam for node operators whose external tools call CreateNewBlock() frequently. Issue #36334 highlighted that unconditional logging filled disk logs without any option to disable it, making this a worthwhile user-facing logging control.
